name: I Came for You
source:
Yurima begins her training at the Ninja Academy. Intense lessons, challenges that test her limits, and feelings that sometimes defy the rules — she faces it all, unaware that from the very first day, she has become part of someone else’s plan.

[From [url=https://lyoka-gl.itch.io/i-came-for-you]Itch.io[/url]]
